xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3092: verdict writes must survive record-lock contention — verdict-aware merge, bounded backoff, contention surfacing, frozen-agent escalation

plan.title: Review agent's own record lock blocks its own verdict write: specialists/done collides, fallback is consumed, reviewStatus stuck at reviewing (MIN-902)
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: A completed specialist verdict can fail to reach any persisted plane while every mechanism reports success. pipeline.updatedAt is stamped on every status write, so every newer-wins comparison (pickNewerPipeline at src/lib/pan-dir/records.ts:316, the drain supersede check at src/lib/overdeck/review-status-record-sync.ts:404) treats a newer-but-verdict-free write as newer truth: the drain deletes the workspace fallback unlanded, or the fold is silently dropped during the record write while reporting success. The agent whose signal did not land retries at LLM-turn cost (~$5/hr observed on MIN-902) with no backoff or cap, and a frozen agent that never executed the write contract (MIN-858) is invisible: decideUnsignaledTestAction returns 'none' forever after one nudge. Operator constraint (issue comment 4): do NOT break or bypass the record lock — add backoff, surface long contention, make the frozen mode recoverable from outside the agent.
narratives.Proposal: Four coordinated fixes around the untouched lock protocol. (1) Verdict-aware merge: a new src/lib/pan-dir/pipeline-verdict-merge.ts makes pickNewerPipeline and the drain supersede check content-aware — terminal verdicts survive newer verdict-free writes from the same review cycle; newer cycles (reviewSpawnedAt) and newer terminal verdicts still win. (2) Bounded in-process backoff: a journal write introducing a NEW terminal verdict retries updateIssueRecordForIssue with exponential backoff (~2.6 min, env OVERDECK_VERDICT_BACKOFF_DELAYS_MS) before falling back to the workspace file, so pan admin specialists done waits in-process instead of burning LLM turns; the CLI then prints an explicit do-not-retry message when the fallback holds the verdict. (3) A deacon sweep patrol drains stranded fallbacks every patrol cycle and emits one needs-you per episode when a fallback stays undrained past 10 min. (4) Frozen-agent escalation: a live idle test session with no verdict artifact escalates to needs-you after the nudge grace instead of 'none' forever (never fabricates a verdict). Role prompts gain the stop-signal contract (verdict in fallback/artifact is durable; do not re-run the signal).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No changes to the record lock protocol: no lock-exempt writes, no changes to RECORD_LOCK_RETRY_DELAYS_MS or the 30s durability budget, no specialists/done exemption (operator directive, issue comment 4)
- No reconstruction of the already-lost MIN-858/MIN-902 verdicts (MIN-902 already landed; MIN-858 is operator-handled)
- No new review-role verdict artifact contract (the fallback file plus existing .pan/review/<runId>/ verdict-report patrols suffice)
- No verdict fabrication anywhere: recovery only from written evidence (fallback, artifact, verdict report); frozen mode escalates to the operator
- No cross-machine verdict transport for remote/Fly agents
- No changes to the journal→DB read-overlay semantics beyond what the consumption fix makes unnecessary

autoDecisions.summary: Content-aware verdict merge in one new module over re-architecting pipeline.updatedAt stamps
autoDecisions.rationale: Contained to two call sites (pickNewerPipeline, drain supersede); preserves PAN-2587 newer-wins for all non-verdict fields; a per-gate verdictUpdatedAt refactor would touch every writer and reader.

autoDecisions.summary: In-process backoff capped at ~2.6 min (2s/5s/10s/20s/40s/80s), long tail owned by the deacon sweep patrol
autoDecisions.rationale: MIN-902's hour-long contention was the outlier; the agent-facing budget stays short so the CLI never blocks more than a few minutes, and the server-side sweep retries indefinitely at zero token cost.

autoDecisions.summary: Contention surfacing is duration-based (10 min) not spend-based
autoDecisions.rationale: Once retries happen in-process, LLM spend is ~0; elapsed time is the honest residual signal and a duration threshold in the long-lived server is mechanically simple.

autoDecisions.summary: Frozen mode escalates to needs-you; never fabricates a verdict
autoDecisions.rationale: D6 in test-verdict.ts (never guess pass/fail) outranks automation — a pane-only verdict behind a live session is an operator decision.
The review role already has the fallback file and two deacon patrols reading .pan/review/<runId>/ verdict reports; the consumption fix plus the sweep close the hole without a third contract.

autoDecisions.summary: reviewSpawnedAt is the new-cycle identity for the merge override
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the cycle marker setReviewStatusSync's existing regression guards (review-status.ts:201-219) already use — one consistent notion of cycle.

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/pan-dir/pipeline-verdict-merge.ts (type-only imports from records.ts — no runtime cycle) exporting TERMINAL_GATE_VALUES, GATE_COMPANIONS, mergePipelineVerdictAware(rebuilt, fresh), and pipelineCoversFallbackVerdicts(journal, fallback). Terminal values: reviewStatus passed|blocked|failed|skipped; testStatus passed|failed; uatStatus passed|blocked|failed; verificationStatus passed|failed|skipped; inspectStatus passed|blocked|failed; mergeStatus merged|failed. Companions: reviewStatus→reviewNotes/reviewedAtCommit/reviewerVerdicts; testStatus→testNotes; uatStatus→uatNotes; verificationStatus→verificationNotes/lastVerifiedCommit; inspectStatus→inspectNotes; mergeStatus→mergeNotes/mergeStep. mergePipelineVerdictAware rules in order: (1) missing either updatedAt → rebuilt; (2) rebuilt.updatedAt >= fresh.updatedAt → rebuilt; (3) base = structuredClone(fresh); (4) both reviewSpawnedAt parse and fresh's is newer → return base (new-cycle reset); (5) per gate, rebuilt terminal and base non-terminal → copy status + companions from rebuilt; (6) return base. pipelineCoversFallbackVerdicts(journal, fallback): journal.reviewSpawnedAt parses and is > fallback.updatedAt → true; every gate with a terminal fallback value must equal journal's value, else false; no terminal gates in fallback → true. Change pickNewerPipeline (src/lib/pan-dir/records.ts:316-322) to delegate to mergePipelineVerdictAware, keeping the exported name (updateIssueRecordForIssue at records.ts:357 uses it). Extend tests/unit/lib/pan-dir/pipeline-monotonic.test.ts: keep all four PAN-2587 cases green; add (a) MIN-902 repro — rebuilt carries reviewStatus passed at T0 with notes+anchor, fresh is verdict-free at T1>T0 with the same reviewSpawnedAt → merged keeps passed + reviewNotes + reviewedAtCommit and fresh's non-verdict fields; (b) new-cycle reset — fresh has newer reviewSpawnedAt and reviewStatus reviewing → fresh wins wholesale; (c) fresh carries a newer terminal verdict (blocked at T1) over rebuilt's passed at T0 → fresh wins; (d) test-gate preservation — rebuilt testStatus passed, fresh testStatus testing, same cycle → passed + testNotes preserved. See PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-3092.md §FR-1 for the exact rule table.

narrative.Action: In drainWorkspaceVerdictFallback (src/lib/overdeck/review-status-record-sync.ts:403-407), extend the supersede condition from timestamp-only to timestamp AND content: supersede (delete claims, return true) only when journal.updatedAt >= fallback.updatedAt AND pipelineCoversFallbackVerdicts(journal, fallback) (imported from src/lib/pan-dir/pipeline-verdict-merge.ts). Otherwise proceed to the fold. The fold's updateIssueRecordForIssue already routes through the verdict-aware pickNewerPipeline from verdict-aware-pipeline-merge, so a verdict-free newer on-disk pipeline can no longer silently drop the fold. In tests/unit/lib/overdeck/review-status-record-sync-drain.test.ts, split the existing case at line 88 ('deletes the fallback without a record write when the journal is already newer') into two: (a) journal newer AND carrying the same terminal verdict → fallback deleted without a record write; (b) journal newer but verdict-free (e.g. reviewStatus reviewing with a later updatedAt) → drain folds the fallback's verdict into the record and deletes the file. Add (c) journal belongs to a newer cycle (reviewSpawnedAt > fallback.updatedAt) → superseded without folding. Keep every other drain test green.

Bounded exponential backoff for terminal verdict journal writes + CLI do-not-retry message

narrative.Action: Three coordinated changes. (1) src/lib/review-status.ts: setReviewStatusSync already computes terminalReviewVerdict (lines 243-248); extend the same notion to test/uat/verification/inspect/merge status transitions (a NEW terminal value different from the carried status) into a single carriesNewTerminalVerdict boolean and pass it as updateIssueRecordForReviewStatusSync(issueId, updated, { verdictWrite: carriesNewTerminalVerdict }). (2) src/lib/overdeck/review-status-record-sync.ts updateIssueRecordForReviewStatusSync (lines 15-41): accept the third options param; when verdictWrite is set, retry updateIssueRecordForIssue on failure (landed === false or throw) with delays from verdictWriteBackoffDelaysMs() — DEFAULT_VERDICT_BACKOFF_DELAYS_MS = [2000, 5000, 10000, 20000, 40000, 80000] with OVERDECK_VERDICT_BACKOFF_DELAYS_MS comma-list env override (same pattern as recordDurabilityBudgetMs in record-update.ts:39-42) — awaiting setTimeout between attempts; on success keep the landed===true → trackVerdictFallbackDrain behavior; only after schedule exhaustion write the fallback + scheduleVerdictFallbackDrain. Non-verdict writes keep the current single-shot behavior exactly. The retry promise stays in pendingJournalWrites so flushReviewStatusJournalWrites awaits it. (3) src/cli/commands/specialists/done.ts doneAndExitCommand (line 334): after flushReviewStatusJournalWrites(), call readWorkspaceVerdictFallbackSync(normalizedIssueId) (already exported) and when a fallback exists print a chalk.yellow warning: 'Journal write is contended — the verdict is durable at <path>. The host folds it automatically (drain + deacon sweep). Do NOT re-run this signal: repeated signals add lock pressure and burn tokens for nothing.' Tests (NFR-2 — vi.useFakeTimers + advanceTimersByTimeAsync, never real delays): mock updateIssueRecordForIssue to fail N times then land → assert retry schedule, no fallback written, drain tracked; fail always → fallback written only after the full schedule; verdictWrite unset → single attempt then fallback immediately.

Deacon sweep patrol drains stranded verdict fallbacks and surfaces >10min contention

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/deacon-verdict-fallback-sweep.ts exporting sweepStrandedVerdictFallbacks(now = Date.now()): Promise<string[]> per the PRD §FR-4/FR-5 skeleton: iterate loadReviewStatuses(); skip merged/closedOut issues; readWorkspaceVerdictFallback(issueId) (async — covers live path + stranded claims, newest-wins); when present call drainWorkspaceVerdictFallback(issueId) and record an action when drained; when NOT drained and the fallback's age exceeds VERDICT_CONTENTION_SURFACE_MS (10 min) and the issue is not stuck/deaconIgnored, emit ONE activity-log warning (emitActivityEntrySync, source 'cloister', level 'warn') naming the issue, the contention age in minutes, and the current lock owner description, and call recordRecoveryFailure(workspacePath, issueId, 'verdict-fallback-contention', fallback.updatedAt, 1) so a single needs-you trip opens per contention episode (deduped by the fallback's updatedAt as obligationGeneration). Export readOwner from src/lib/pan-dir/fs-lock.ts (currently module-private at line 65) and use readOwner(recordLockPath(project, issueId)) for the lock-owner description. Register the patrol in src/lib/cloister/deacon.ts alongside reconcileUnappliedReviewVerdicts (import wiring near lines 1136-1140 and the patrol-cycle invocation near line 2861); all filesystem access via the async readers (NFR-4 — nothing blocking on the dashboard event loop). Tests in tests/unit/lib/cloister/deacon-verdict-fallback-sweep.test.ts (follow the fake-timer/mocking style of the existing drain tests): (a) stranded fallback with no live claimant is drained and an action recorded; (b) a fallback that keeps failing to drain past 10 min emits exactly one needs-you across multiple sweep cycles; (c) a fallback younger than 10 min is drained-or-deferred with no needs-you; (d) stuck/deaconIgnored issues are drained but never surfaced.

narrative.Action: Add the stop-signal contract to the three prompt surfaces. (1) roles/review.md self-review block (after the signal commands at lines 49-52): 'If the command reports the verdict went to the workspace fallback (journal write contended), the verdict IS durable — do NOT re-run the signal. The host folds it automatically; repeated signals add lock pressure and burn tokens. Continue to your final summary.' (2) roles/test.md near the sentinel steps (lines 73-78): one POST attempt is enough — if it fails, .pan/test/result.json is the durable verdict and the deacon recovers from it; do not retry the POST in a loop; emit the sentinel and stop. (3) src/lib/cloister/test-agent-queue.ts buildTestRolePrompt steps 9-11 (lines 48-56): after the POST steps add the same one-attempt-is-enough instruction pointing at the step-8 artifact as the durable copy. Keep wording short and imperative to match each file's voice. Run any existing prompt-contract tests (src/lib/cloister/__tests__/prompts.test.ts if it covers these files) and keep them green.

narrative.Action: Update the verdict-fallback paragraph in docs/AGENT-STATE-PLANES.md (~lines 30-43) to describe the shipped semantics: (1) the record write door's pipeline merge is verdict-aware — a terminal verdict is never displaced by a newer verdict-free write from the same review cycle, and only a newer reviewSpawnedAt or a newer terminal verdict supersedes it; (2) the fallback drain's supersede check is content-aware (journal must carry the fallback's terminal verdicts or belong to a newer cycle); (3) terminal verdict writes retry the journal write in-process with exponential backoff (OVERDECK_VERDICT_BACKOFF_DELAYS_MS, default 2s/5s/10s/20s/40s/80s) before the workspace fallback is written; (4) the deacon sweep patrol (deacon-verdict-fallback-sweep.ts) drains stranded fallbacks every patrol cycle and opens one needs-you per episode after 10 min of contention; (5) a live idle test session with no verdict artifact escalates to needs-you instead of being ignored after one nudge. Match the doc's existing terse reference style.
